content:
Maya Chen: Hey team — kicking off OmniHealth onboarding thread. Goal: align stakeholders, define success criteria, and confirm 30/60/90 timeline. Quick intro: Raj is our CS lead for the account, Connor is the SE.

Leo Martinez: Thanks Maya. Who from OmniHealth will be our day-to-day?

Maya Chen: Olivia (OmniHealth PM) will be primary contact. Exec sponsor is Dr. Gomez. Legal and security review starts next week per their note.

Priya Nair: For enablement, I can run two sessions: "Admin setup & RBAC" and "Query tuning and embeddings". Prefer Wed/Thu next week.

Connor Lee: I’ll own technical onboarding (integration, keys, env). Need their infra diagram + expected traffic patterns. Can someone pull that from the intake doc?

Raj Patel: I grabbed the intake — sending link: https://drive.redwood/omni/intake (internal). Key bits: expected 5k requests/day burst to 20k, PII filters required, and single-region (us-west).

Maya Chen: Success criteria proposals: 1) Production integration end-to-end with sample flow (seeded prompts) 2) Latency under 350ms p50 for pilot routes 3) No PII leakage in 2-week eval 4) First ROI metric dashboard showing token spend within 10% of projection. Thoughts?

Leo Martinez: Those look good. Add: clear rollback/fallback plan for model degradations and an agreed SLA for incidents during pilot (response < 1 hour for sev2).

Connor Lee: For the integration checklist, adding a snippet for keys and local test:

```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redwood_XXXX
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"test prompt"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Connor Lee: Also need their IP allowlist for private deployment, or we'll use dedicated with TLS and KMS.

Priya Nair: Enablement plan draft: Day 0: Kickoff & creds; Day 7: Admin & security session; Day 14: Developer integration workshop; Day 30: Pilot handoff & ops runbook review.

Maya Chen: Timeline looks aligned with their legal window. Risks: 1) Security questionnaire may delay keys 2) Their data team wants embeddings mapping — may require additional compute/quantization tuning 3) Exec availability for final sign-off.

Raj Patel: Mitigation: prioritize security questionnaire answers — Raj to own; Connor to prep a minimal env for earlier testing without full legal sign-off (QA staging only).

OpsBot: Note created: OmniHealth onboarding / Kickoff created by Maya Chen — task IDs: ONB-439, ONB-440.

Leo Martinez: Quick ask — can we capture their pilot prompts and expected accuracy criteria? That will help Optimize recommendations.

Maya Chen: Yes — Olivia is sending example prompts and target KPI sheet by EOD tomorrow. I'll add to the onboarding folder and tag this thread.

Connor Lee: I'll schedule a deep-dive for infra on Friday 10am PT. Sending invite.

Priya Nair: I'll prep a short enablement feedback form to capture whether docs/sessions meet their needs (1-5 scale + open comments).

Raj Patel: Next steps owners: Raj -> security questionnaire & stakeholder comms; Connor -> infra deep-dive & test env; Priya -> enablement sessions & feedback form; Maya -> overall coordination and timeline.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll post an updated 30/60/90 timeline by tomorrow noon. Please flag any blockers in this thread. :thumbsup:

Leo Martinez: +1.

Priya Nair: 👍

Connor Lee: Got it.

Raj Patel: On it.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for onboarding kickoff. Field __notes is non-essential and included for dataset provenance.
